churches.assessment: Zion BIC in Abilene is one of the founding Brethren in Christ congregations west of the Mississippi, organized in 1887 by River Brethren immigrants from Pennsylvania. The congregation has a notable missions-sending history within the BIC denomination, having produced numerous missionaries and church leaders. Pastor Jay Johnson currently leads, with Thomas Price as youth pastor. The 130-year heritage, plain Anabaptist roots, and small-town Kansas setting make this a meaningful spiritual home for those drawn to peace-church traditions. Yellow rating reflects the BIC denomination's allowance of female pastors, which the local Zion staff does not currently practice.
